permission.audit.history.read: See a record's history on its form (what the user may read of the record)
permission.audit.log.read: See the audit log (changes to the records the user may read)
validation.auditCursor: Give the id of a change this history showed (the last one on screen) to read older changes.
validation.auditRecordType: Name a kind of record the audit trail keeps (schema.table, as the audit log lists them).
